interpretation.main: EOG v3 consolidates ecological-world uncertainty, observation-process uncertainty, exact falsification, projection, and robust next-evidence ranking in one finite-world API.
interpretation.separation: The engine keeps ecological and observation uncertainty separate; ecological conclusions are projections of surviving joint worlds rather than assumptions about a single observation model.
interpretation.planning: Evidence actions are ranked against an explicitly declared inferential target. No action is recommended when none strictly improves the chosen worst-case target.
